codeReview.summary: Fail. The refactor added new routing/voice-log code and text-length validation, but the edge-function entrypoint never executes the farm-query handler and still keeps voice-log state management partially duplicated in main.ts, so the feature does not fully deliver the promised modular routing/handlers behavior.

issues.description: `decideChatRoute()` can return `farm_query`, but `handleRequest()` only branches for `clarify_route` and `voice_log` before falling into the advisory fallback at line 287. That means history/aggregation requests never invoke `handlers/farm-query.ts`; even clarified "2) Show past records" replies still go through the advisory LLM path instead of deterministic farm data queries.

`main.ts` reimplements the voice-log state machine instead of using `handleVoiceLog()`, and it never persists `voice_log_expected_field` or resets `voice_log_clarify_attempts`/`voice_log_expected_field` on ready/cancelled paths. After one partially clarified log, stale clarification state can leak into later turns and shorten future clarification flows.

The replacement router is still a 1406-line file (`wc -l`), which violates the documented `<500` line module limit in `AGENTS.md` and `backend-worker/SKILL.md`. The feature removed `voice-routing.ts`, but it replaced it with another large monolith rather than the promised cleanly split modules.
